# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
supersessions:
  - from: OD-P2-07
    to: OA-P2-06
    scope: stop condition
    note: >-
      OA-P2-06 otherwise stays ACTIVE, annotated "partially superseded: stop condition"; OD-P2-08 section 8's
      stop conditions are the current ones
    cite: {path: release/orchestration/phase-2/GATES/OWNER-DECISION-P2-0007-A-PLUS-C-STRUCTURAL-REMEDIATION.md,
           line: 9, quote: "continuation **beyond** OA-P2-06's previous stop condition"}
  - from: V8.2
    to: V8.1
    scope: WHOLE
    cite: {path: release/orchestration/phase-1/ORCHESTRATOR_STATE.yaml, line: 70,
           quote: "HISTORICAL_PHASE_1_OPERATOR_EVIDENCE"}
  - from: OWNER-DIRECTIVE-0004
    to: CP-1
    scope: WHOLE
    note: retired as the Phase-1 target
    cite: {path: release/orchestration/phase-1/GATES/OWNER-DIRECTIVE-0004-SIGNED-RELEASE-ROOT-REBASE.md, line: 43,
           quote: "CP-1 is retired as the Phase-1 target"}
  - from: 'V8_3_EVIDENCE_PACKAGE.md#5.0'
    to: 'V8_3_EVIDENCE_PACKAGE.md#5.3(only serialised runs are authoritative)'
    scope: section
    note: the sentence "only serialised runs are authoritative" (and the earlier seven-defect figure) is retracted by
      section 5.0's current-truth block and corroborated by PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSTIC.md's independent arithmetic
    cite: {path: release/orchestration/phase-2/V8_3_EVIDENCE_PACKAGE.md, line: 253,
           quote: "Anything in §5 that disagrees with this block is"}
    corroboration: {path: release/orchestration/phase-2/PERFORMANCE_DIAGNOSTIC.md, line: 177,
           quote: 'the "serialised band" itself does not survive scrutiny'}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# lifecycle_overrides: derivation REGISTRY_CITED. Sets both class and lifecycle directly for `unit` (a record id or
# `path#heading`); only ever used to RESTRICT (here: to WITHDRAWN/EVIDENCE_WITHDRAWN, never to raise a class).
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
lifecycle_overrides:
  - unit: DESIGN-P2-AR0096-POSITIVE-CONTROL-GAP
    lifecycle: WITHDRAWN
    class: EVIDENCE_WITHDRAWN
    cite: {path: release/orchestration/phase-2/RESEARCH/P2-AR0096-POSITIVE-CONTROL-GAP.md, line: 6,
           quote: "WITHDRAWN 2026-09-25"}

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# class_rules: glob -> class, data only, FIRST match wins, gives a class, NEVER an ACTIVE lifecycle (ARCHITECTURE.md
# section 5.2 rule 4). Applied only when nothing above (mandatory_bridge_inputs item, section_anchors, structured
# YAML/header-table metadata) already assigned a class. The ladder rows come from BR-HO-0001 section 2.2 item 2.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class_rules:
  - {glob: 'release/orchestration/*/GATES/OWNER-*.md', class: OWNER_DECISION,
     note: 'section-scoped when section_anchors above anchors items inside the file -- see unanchored_lines_rule'}
  - {glob: 'release/orchestration/phase-2-context-bridge/GATES/OWNER-*.md', class: OWNER_DECISION}
  - {glob: 'Governance_OS_Capability_Acceptance_Contract_v3.md', class: CONTRACT}
  - {glob: 'framework/contracts/source/*.md', class: CONTRACT}
  - {glob: 'framework/contracts/*.yaml', class: CONTRACT, type: compiled-derived}
  - {glob: 'release/orchestration/phase-2/GATES/PHASE-2-FROZEN-GATE-CONTRACT.md', class: FROZEN_GATE_CONTRACT}
  - {glob: 'spec/decisions/*.yaml', class: ARCHITECTURE_DECISION}
  - {glob: 'spec/architecture/*.yaml', class: ARCHITECTURE_DECISION}
